newsitem.title: SIERRA LEONE: Nigerian-led forces attack Freetown coupmakers.
newsitem.headline: Nigerian-led forces attack Freetown coupmakers.

text.p: Heavy bombardments erupted in Freetown on Monday as Nigerian-led West African forces launched an attack on Sierra Leone's coup leaders, witnesses said.

The booming of heavy guns shook the capital at 6 A.M. (0600 GMT) as Nigerian naval vessels opened fire from the sea. It was not immediately clear what they were firing at and there was no sign of explosions near the coup leaders' headquarters.
"The attack has started," said a West African military official in the capital.
There was no sign of fighting by troops on the ground. The street outside the hotel where most remaining foreigners had sheltered was quiet.

The attack came a day after diplomats made a desperate attempt to reach agreement for a peaceful end to the crisis following the May 25 coup by junior officers -- and hours after the coup leader announced appointments to a ruling council.
